udakarahada.p: [Udaka+rahada] (pu) CL=7 (1) The ocean. (2) The pond. The Lake.

B:
udakarahada： udakarahada（pu）
ဥဒကရဟဒ（ပု）
«udaka+rahada»
[ဥဒက+ရဟဒ]
K:
udakarahada：ဥဒကရဟဒ（ပု）
[ဥဒက+ရဟဒ]
（၁） သမုဒြာ။ （၂） ရေအိုင်၊ ရေကန်။
R:
udakarahada：ဥဒက-ရဟဒ （ပ）
ရေအိုင်။
CPD: udaka-rahada , m., a lake, pond; Himavante mahā ~o, Ja ll 341, 22 ; frequent ( and almost exclusiv- ely ) in similes: ~o ubbhidodako, D l 74, 20 — M l 276, 37 = ll 15, 23 = lll 93, 10 = A lll 25, 28 ; pabbata- saṃkhepe ~o accho vippasanno anāvilo, D l 84, 13 = M l 279, 33 = ll 22, 5 ≠ A l 9, 17 ; ~o āvilo lulito kalalī-bhūto, A l 9, 7 (= udaka-daho, Mp l 57, 8 ); pabbata-saṃkhepe ~o nivāto vigata-ūmiko, A lll 396, 18 ; parinibbuto ~o va sīto, Sn 467; pipāsitānaṃ ~o va sīto, Ja V 84, 16* ; seyyathā pi . . . puriso sappi-kumbhaṃ vā tela-kumbhaṃ vā gambhīraṃ ~aṃ ogāhetvā bhindeyya . . . , S lV 313, 28 = V 370, 9 = Nett 46, 26 (ogāhitvā); seyyathā pi . . . soṇḍikā- kamma-karo soṇḍikā-kilañjaṃ gambhīre ~e pakkhi- pitvā, M l 228, 33 = 374, 31 ; seyyathā pi bāḷisiko . . . baḷisaṃ gambhīre ~e pakkhipeyya, S ll 226, 13 = lV 158, 27 ≠ 312, 26 ; cattāro 'me ~ā . . . : uttāno gambhīrobhāso . . . , A ll 105, 9, 14 — Pp 46, 14 ; sukhuma-cchidena jālena parivuto viya ~o, Ud-a 367, 13 ; — ifc. mahā- ° (A V 202, 11 ); ° 'ūpama , mfn. comparable to a lake; cattāro 'me ~ā puggalā, A ll 105, 19 — 106, 26 ≠ Pp 46, 13 — 47, 6 .

udakarahadūpama.p: [Udakarahada+upamā] (ti) CL=7 It has an example of a pond, It is like a pond.
a: ဥဒကရဟဒူပမ(တိ)
ရေအိုင် ဥပမာရှိသော၊ ရေအိုင်နှင့်တူသော။

udakarāsi.p: [Udaka+rāsi] (pu) CL=7 A heap of water.

ရေအစု။
CPD: udaka-rāsi , m., a mass of water; mahā eso ~i, S lV 157, 5 ( quoted Nett 154, 27 ); kathaṃ (vāto) tāva- mahantaṃ ~iṃ ghanaṃ karoti ?, Vism 417, 11 .
